envelope.description: Add a TOML-parsing dependency and walkProjectMcpConfigLayers

body.title: Add a TOML-parsing dependency and walkProjectMcpConfigLayers
body.summary: Add a minimal, pure-ESM TOML-parsing dependency (this repo has none today); implement walkProjectMcpConfigLayers(cwd), which resolves the global config's exact file path once and walks cwd to the filesystem root, skipping only the one layer whose own .codex/config.toml path exactly equals that resolved global path, parsing every other layer's config.toml and checking whether its mcp_servers value is non-empty.
acceptanceChecks: walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false for the default case (home directory's own config.toml is the global config, declaring mcp_servers.insrc)

walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns true when a genuine ancestor layer (CODEX_HOME nested inside the project tree, project root distinct from CODEX_HOME) declares its own mcp_servers table, and false for the same layout with no such declaration
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false when CODEX_HOME lies entirely outside cwd's ancestor chain
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns true for each of the four valid TOML forms (dotted header, bare header with dotted/nested keys, inline-table assignment, top-level dotted key-value)
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers propagates a plain Error (not false) on a non-ENOENT read/parse failure at a non-excluded layer

tests.name: walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false for a cwd beneath a mocked home directory whose .codex/config.toml (the mocked global config) declares mcp_servers.insrc -- the default-case positive regression test

THE REGRESSION TEST FOR THIS ROUND'S FINDING, using the exact cited layout: mocked CODEX_HOME=/work/repo/codex-state (declaring mcp_servers.insrc), mocked cwd=/work/repo/src, and a mocked /work/repo/.codex/config.toml declaring a mutation-sentinel server -- walkProjectMcpConfigLayers must return TRUE (the sentinel at the project root is still detected and refused) while the SEPARATE case of the same layout with NO sentinel at /work/repo must return false (global insrc remains allowed)

walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false when a mocked CODEX_HOME lies entirely outside cwd's own ancestor chain -- the exclusion comparison never matches, and the walk otherwise behaves exactly as the unbounded design would
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns true when a genuine ancestor project layer (distinct from the global config by path) declares its own mcp_servers table, for each of the four valid TOML forms
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false for a cwd chain with no non-excluded .codex/config.toml at all
